readme_text: By default, models are scored on **50 starting words** with **3 trials per word**.
The main score is the **sum of valid transitions in the longest valid chain prefix** across all starting words.

Each word in the chain must differ from the previous one by a **Levenshtein distance of 1** (i.e., one insert, delete, or substitution), all intermediate words have to be in the dictionary and **no repetitions are allowed**.

The row's section states its reasoning mode ("Thinking Models" / "Non-thinking Models"); a parenthesis states a level ("GPT-5.2 (xhigh)", "GPT-5.2 (none)"). Leaderboard last updated 2026-01-22.
